text:
maria: Quick heads-up before I hand off to @devon in ~10m — I'm going to reroute low-priority infra alerts to #eng-oncall-info and bump the noise thresholds for a few bursty signals. This is just for the quiet-hours cutover; full routing restored tomorrow morning.

aj: Which alerts are you marking low-priority?

maria: CPU transient spikes on batch-gpu nodes (alerts with <5m sustained), ephemeral OOMs in model-cache that auto-recover, and a couple of noisy k8s probe flaps. NOT touching model-serving p99 latency or job-queue-saturation.

aj: Cool. Please leave the rollback command pinned in the thread. Would like to avoid surprises. :eyes:

maria: Will do. Rollback is one-liner: `infra-cli alert-route set --policy-id 987 --route primary` (or use the console toggle). I'll also annotate the runbook with the change and the exact policy IDs.

maria: Routing change snippet I'm applying now:
```json
{"policy_id":987, "from":"pager", "to":"#eng-oncall-info", "snooze_seconds":14400, "notes":"quiet-hours cutover - low priority"}
```

oncall-bot: routing change for policy 987 queued by maria — will apply in 15s.

oncall-bot: routing change applied successfully. old_route=pager new_route=#eng-oncall-info actor=maria

devon: Ack, thanks. I'll take over in 10 and watch dashboards for the 30m after cutover. I'll also add a short note in the handoff doc: https://redwood.internal/handoffs/1776509876

aj: Can we also temporarily increase the alert threshold for `k8s/probe-flap` to 6 failures in 5m? That one wakes me up for infra flapping we usually ignore.

maria: Good call. Updating that policy too: `infra-cli alert-edit --name k8s/probe-flap --threshold 6 --window 300`

oncall-bot: alert policy k8s/probe-flap updated (threshold=6 window=300) by maria

leo: FYI I'm on backup from 00:00–04:00 UTC tonight. If anything looks off and devon is out, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

devon: Noted. If we see >3 recurrences of OOM within 15m I'll escalate back to pager. Leaving that in the runbook.

maria: I'll monitor metrics for 30m post-change, if CPU or p99 latency jumps I'll rollback immediately. Rollback command again: `infra-cli alert-route set --policy-id 987 --route primary`

aj: Thanks — sounds good. I'll update the oncall schedule doc with leo as backup.

devon: ack. small heads-up: watch the batching router queue depth around 02:00 UTC — we've seen stray spikes after routing tweaks in the past.

maria: noted, will keep eyes on queue depth and batching throughput graph (dash: infra/batching/queue-depth).

leo: :thumbsup: If anything noisy appears, we can flip those policies back within 2 mins.

maria: handing off to @devon now. All config changes are in the change log and I pinned the runbook edit. Good luck everyone.

devon: taking over — will post a short status update in 20m.

oncall-bot: message reminder — devon is now on-call primary for the next shift (start_ts=1776509886)

maria: thanks, leaving the thread. :wave:
